description: Language audit configuration for CAYC public-facing copy. See docs/style-guide.md for the rules this enforces.

banned_terms.message: Public copy must not describe CAYC as a stablecoin. See docs/style-guide.md Section 2 for approved replacement terms.
Variants of 'stablecoin' (hyphenated or space-separated) are also banned. See docs/style-guide.md Section 2.
CAYC is not backed by anything. Do not use 'backed by' in public copy. See docs/style-guide.md Section 2.
CAYC has no redemption mechanism. Do not use 'redeemable' in public copy. See docs/style-guide.md Section 2.
'1:1 with USDC' implies backing. Use 'USDC-referenced' or describe the decimal match explicitly. See docs/style-guide.md Section 2.
Claims of a fixed dollar value are factually wrong and legally exposed. See docs/style-guide.md Section 2.

allowlisted_contexts.rationale: The Legal posture section explicitly disclaims stablecoin status and must retain the word 'stablecoin' to do so.

allowlisted_contexts.section_anchor: ## What these policies do NOT cover
allowlisted_contexts.rationale: This section describes CAYC's peg mechanism by saying there is NO peg contract; the negation of stablecoin status is the point of the paragraph.

allowlisted_lines.rationale: Explicit negation is always permitted (case variant of above).

Explicit negation with qualifier word (e.g., 'not a regulated stablecoin', 'not a payment stablecoin', 'not a reserve-backed stablecoin'). The [*]{0,2} allows markdown bold formatting ('**not**' → 'not**' + ' a ...').
Explicit negation of redemption (e.g., 'is not redeemable at par'). CAYC explicitly disclaims redeemability.
Explicit statement that there is no redemption mechanism (e.g., 'has no redemption right', 'there is no redemption mechanism').
Style Guide Section 6 case 3: 'payment stablecoin' is the specific GENIUS-Act definitional term. Permitted when referring to the regulated category (always as negation or reference).
Style Guide Section 6 case 3: 'algorithmic stablecoin' is a reference to the historical category of algorithmic pegs (Terra/UST, USR). Permitted as reference to other projects.
Reference to the 'stablecoin-compliance checklist' regulated-category concept, not a description of CAYC.
Hyphenated adjective form 'regulated-stablecoin classification' denotes the regulated category itself, not a description of CAYC.
'Stablecoin Issuer' (e.g., 'Permitted Payment Stablecoin Issuer') is a statutory role under the GENIUS Act, referenced in negations.
Explicit negation (e.g., 'never a stablecoin', 'never use stablecoin').
Explicit negation pattern used in repo README disclaimer.

Style Guide Section 6 case 3: 'regulated stablecoin' is the technical/legal category CAYC is explicitly NOT. Permitted when referring to the regulated category itself (GENIUS-Act/MiCA term) or to other projects (USDC/USDT) that ARE regulated stablecoins.
